//TR: Bu checkpoint V7 PS-1B masaüstü Project Studio paketinin (sihirbaz, içe aktarma, dev-run + önizleme, dosyalar/diff, dışa aktarma, yürütücü kurulumu) yalnız gözlenen sonuçlarını kaydeder; temiz değildir, bağımsız inceleme beklemektedir.
status: IMPLEMENTED, NOT CLEAN; independent review pending
backendDependency: PS-1A backend routes are not in this lineage; every new read returns HTTP 404 here and the UI shows honest UNAVAILABLE (observed in the real Electron launch). No data is faked.

decisions.preview: shell.openExternal to the default browser, chosen over an in-app isolated BrowserWindow: generated app code never enters the Electron process/session or IPC surface. The URL is read by the main process from backend devrun state (RUNNING + AVAILABLE + exact http://127.0.0.1:<port>/, port 1024-65535, not the Control API port, matching devrun.port), never taken from the renderer.
decisions.importPaths: Paths come only from a main-process native open dialog; main remembers up to 8 issued paths and rejects an import POST whose {kind,path} was not issued (consumed on 2xx).
decisions.exportFolder: Main fetches the export record itself, realpath-resolves the path and only shows it when strictly inside <dataDir>/exports (packaged: userData/workos/exports; dev: UASCO_DATA_DIR or .ai/workos/exports).
